ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Advent Hotels International Limited has confirmed compliance with SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, through a certificate from its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, MUFG Intime India Private Limited. This verifies that all dematerialization requests were processed accurately, timely, and correctly recorded in the register of members, ensuring the integrity of the company's shareholder records. The document reflects routine regulatory adherence with no material impacts or red flags identified.
